$comment: Cells adapter controlled configuration (file-storage/adapter/src/query-revision.mjs configuration()). Render with: adapter-delivery.py config --plan <bind plan> --template this --delivery-dir <CELLS_ADAPTER_DELIVERY_DIR> --env-file <platform deploy/local/.env> --action-token-signing-file <ACTION_TOKEN_SIGNING_FILE> --public-file action-token-jwks.json=<signing jwksFile> --public-file gateway-service-jwks.json=<GATEWAY_SERVICE_JWKS_FILE> --set nativeRootRef=<Cells workspace root node UUID> --set downloadOrigin=<CELLS_EXTERNAL> --release-dir <rendered release> --registration contracts/adapter/file_storage.v1/registration.json --out <CELLS_ADAPTER_CONFIG_FILE>. bindingId, tenantId, workspaceId and management.validation come from the plan. FILE_STORAGE@v1 has no optional operation: Core requires the adapter to map all seven release actions (component_release.rs validate_declarations; application_binding_native.rs validate), so readEdge, readExecution (the native read Task that list/read/list_revisions/export execute through, node-execution.mjs), write, delete, share and cellShare are mandatory. Their nativeJobId values are the deterministic {{job:*}} identities that file-storage-native-action.template.json renders into the native delivery (file-storage/deploy/start.sh --platform-adapter compares them). readExecution/delete/share usageMeasurements are the approved release's explicit empty meter set: every Cells action declares quotaPolicy NONE, meters [] and usageSource NONE and the capability declares meter UNSUPPORTED (design 08 §9.2 registers no Cells delete/share meter; Core has no governed registration path for release-declared OpenMeter meters yet). A later release that declares meters must change this mapping to the same COUNT meter keys; the adapter refuses extract_usage while the mapping is empty.
